---
description: Apply DEVS AI authoring rules to installable skill packages.
applyTo: ".agents/skills/**"
---

Read `standards/skill-authoring.md`. Keep packages standalone, source-backed, and
business-focused. Use name/description-only portable frontmatter and local resources.
Write meaningful synthetic examples and edge cases. Helpers use Python's standard
library and perform no network/model calls. Keep promotions in metadata and website
content. Regenerate shared surfaces after changes and report only checks actually run.
